settings.text: Frequently Asked Questions

settings.heading: When should I drink Daily Melt?

settings.text: Enjoy Daily Melt whenever it best fits your routine – before or after a meal, as an afternoon pick-me-up, or when you want something chocolatey. For best results, enjoy one serving daily. Consistency matters more than timing.

Deep dark chocolate with subtle sweetness and a warm cinnamon finish. Organic cacao and cocoa create its rich chocolate depth, while carob, Ceylon cinnamon, and monk fruit round out every smooth, creamy cup. It’s indulgent without tasting overly sweet.

settings.heading: How is this different from regular hot chocolate?

settings.text: Daily Melt is more than a chocolate treat. It combines rich cacao with clinically studied ingredients that support natural GLP-1 production, satiety, healthy blood sugar levels, and metabolic health.*

settings.heading: Will this help me lose weight?

settings.text:
Daily Melt is designed to support healthy weight management by promoting satiety, helping manage cravings, and supporting metabolic health.*

It isn’t a weight-loss medication or quick fix, and results vary. It works best alongside balanced nutrition, regular movement, and other healthy habits.

settings.heading: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?

settings.text: Absolutely. You can pause, skip, modify, or cancel future shipments through your account portal.

settings.heading: Is Daily Melt safe for my diet?

settings.text: Daily Melt is vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, soy-free, and made with non-GMO ingredients. It contains no artificial additives. Always review the complete ingredient and allergen information, and consult your healthcare provider if you have a medical condition or take medication.
Each package contains 25 servings (one month supply at one serving per day).

settings.heading: Does Daily Melt contain caffeine or stimulants?

settings.text: Daily Melt contains naturally occurring compounds from cacao, so this answer should reflect the actual caffeine and theobromine content.

settings.text: Yes! Try Daily Melt risk-free for 30 days. If you're not satisfied, contact us for a full refund—no questions asked.
Daily Melt is sweetened with monk fruit for a balanced sweetness without artificial sweeteners.
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. No refrigeration needed.

settings.heading: Can I add it to coffee or smoothies?

settings.text: Absolutely! Many customers add Daily Melt to their morning coffee for a mocha flavor, or blend it into smoothies and protein shakes.
